Usage: when [options] [<input> [+/-offset] | diff <time1> <time2>]

Convert timestamps between formats, apply time arithmetic, and calculate durations.

Options:
  --utc                        Output only UTC ISO 8601 string (conversion mode)
  --local                      Output only local ISO 8601 string (conversion mode)
  --iso                        Output only ISO 8601 duration string (diff mode)
  --tz ZONE                    Display in this timezone (IANA or Windows ID)
  -h, --help                   Show help
  --version                    Show version
  --no-color                   Disable colored output
  --json                       JSON output
  --describe                   Structured JSON metadata for AI agents
  --color[=auto|always|never]  Coloured output: auto (default when omitted), always, or never

Input Formats:
  now                  Current instant
  Unix epoch           1718745600 (seconds, 1-10 digits) or 1718745600000 (millis, 11-13 digits)
  ISO 8601 date        2024-06-18 (treated as midnight UTC)
  ISO 8601 datetime    2024-06-18T16:00:00Z (with or without timezone offset)
  Note: bare 4-digit values like 2025 are rejected as year/epoch-ambiguous (see 'man when').

Offsets:
  +/-N{d,h,m,s}        Relative offset, e.g. +7d or -2h30m
  ISO 8601 duration    e.g. +P1DT12H (days/hours/minutes/seconds only)

Examples:
  when 1718745600                  Convert a Unix epoch to all formats
  when now                         Show current time in all formats
  when now --tz Asia/Tokyo         Show current time in Tokyo
  when now +7d                     Show the date 7 days from now
  when now --utc                   Pipe-friendly UTC timestamp
  when diff 2024-06-18 2024-06-25  Calculate duration between two dates
  when diff now 2024-12-25 --iso   ISO 8601 duration until Christmas

Composes with:
  cat epochs.txt | wargs when             Convert a list of epochs
  timeit when diff 2024-01-01 2024-12-31  Time the diff calculation

Exit Codes:
  0    Success
  125  Usage error — bad arguments,
